title: Best free calendar application in all of the internet
body: Before using this, i used a physical diary. A physical diary is impractical as to carry it everywhere along with a pen plus it’s limited space and also my life became more demanding which prompted me to find an alternative. I tried a couple of calendar apps but I’ll spare you the details. Essentially, this app was the best. Other apps asked for a paid subscription and if you didn’t, you wouldn’t access to basic features such as being able set alerts once an event begins(ironic because this feature is also limited in this program but ill get to it). The ability to EASILY drag tasks/events to certain times or days, was a feature that really is intuitive and I think would make a difference in the 90% of people reading this review. Not only that but what they call “inbox” in this program also doubles down as a to-do list which is incredibly handy. Having one app that takes all these needs is super beneficial. However I would give this program a 4.8/5 if they was an option. And that is the ability to being able to set alerts prior to an event/task AND able to repeat events. Of course if you pay for their paid subscription, you’ll get these features. However, I believe that these two are fundamental features to a calander app and I know for a lot of people, it can be a deal breaker, if they dont have one or both of these features. Other than that though, no complaints whatsover. Excellent Excellent program that really has been programmed with care and precision making sure every part of the user experience is smooth and intuitive. At least on my MacBook Air. I would expect the same on all other devices. It runs well on my iPhone too. Thank you developers for creating such an extraordinary program

title: Great for my silly lil Neurospicy brain
body:
I massively struggle with time management and task hopping due to my ADHD, even with medication, and am constantly making & losing track of to-do lists. Structured helps me prioritise tasks, colour code the things I need to for uni/work/personal life/medical needs etc, gives me much needed timely reminders AND I get a fun little dopamine reward boost every time I check something off. My fave feature is the inbox; whenever I think of something I need to do I can just jot it down in the moment without having to commit to when to do it, and then when I have the mental capacity to organise myself I can easily transfer it into the calendar. I also love the cute suggestions for small time gaps - yah I absolutely do want a stretch/snack, thank you, I forgot to eat and take care of myself again oops 🫠

The only gripe I have is that when I delete an event in my Apple calendar that has already transferred to structured, it doesn’t also update the event in the structured app, so I end up having to edit two calendars. But that might be due to my rather embarrassing inability to work technology so take it as you will. Yeah I forget to use it for days at a time, but I still love it. 10/10 would recommend.

body:
I have used this app on and off for a while now and just recently paid for an annual access to try the AI planner.  I have to say… wow! This app is the pinnacle of brilliant UX/UI.  I’m ADHD (was diagnosed before the smart phone was invented :p) and my concept of time has always been terrible.  This app allows me to see the reality of how long it takes to do things and visually shows me where I need to take breaks or allow a buffer zone for timings. The AI app allows you to use your voice to plan things so even if you have planned your morning you can add stuff like “after 12pm I need to do ‘x’, then ‘y for 30mins’ etc”.  
The only suggestion I would make is allowing your inbox to have subcategories so you don’t have to switch over to the reminders app, e.g priority tasks. 
Brilliant! Just download it and try it, even the free version is great!

title: Too much clicking
body:
Loving the idea of integrating to-do list and timeline. However, after trying this app for a week I started to feel its a bit tedious to use. 

For example, when I want to add a task that has been created in the inbox to today's timeline, I have to: 1)Click the   button; 2) Scroll to pick a time when the task should start; 3) Click to choose the duration of the task; 4) Most of the time in my case, tasks last for longer than 1.5h, which is the longest one provided by default, so I have to click on 'More', click and type in 'hour', click and type in 'min', and I can't use tab to move from 'hour' to 'min' as it just allows me to type more space in the 'hour' textbox! After all these I need to click on 'Add Task' to complete the process. If I want to modify the task after adding it to timeline, I have to go through all these again! 

Some suggestions/feature requests:
1. It would be very useful if I can just drag the task from inbox, drop it to a desired starting time in the timeline. By doing so it will create a block on my timeline with a duration of one hour by default. And then I can extend or shorten the duration by draging the bottom of the block.
2. Remove tasks from timeline back to inbox, by drag-and-drop ideally.

I like this app and would like to see it gets better! Keep it up!

Some things that I’d love to see in future updates are 1) the ability to drag and drop tasks to rearrange them over the course of the day; and 2) the ability to write notes within tasks. Keep up the great work!
